name: Dlanor A. Knox
original_name: ドラノール・A・ノックス
source: Dlanor is the Chief Inquisitor of Eiserne Jungfrau and enforces the commandments of Knox's Decalogue, originally written by Ronald A. Knox. Known as Archbishop Knox, Dlanor is popularly known as "Death Sentence Dlanor" and "Dlanor of the Ten Wedges." She can summon a red blade of light, which differs from the others seen in the series by having a handle.
